_help: Copy this file to ~/.krysalis-os/config.json (or to krysalis-os.config.json in the project root) and edit the paths to match your machine. Anything you leave out auto-detects or falls back to sensible defaults.
_paths_note: Leave as null to auto-detect via `which`. Or paste the full path you get from `which claude` etc.
_vault_note: Full path to your Obsidian vault. Leave null and we'll try ~/Documents/Obsidian Vault, ~/Obsidian, ~/Obsidian Vault.
_agent_note: Which openclaw agent to chat with by default (main, krysalisos, marketing, etc.). Run `openclaw agents list` to see yours.
_seo_note: The SEO generator writes blog posts into these site repos. Leave null to use the built-in default funnel, or list your own. Each entry: { id, name, url, path }. `path` is the repo root (absolute or ~/...); postsDir defaults to <path>/src/blog/posts (override with an optional `postsDir`). Example: [{ "id": "mysite", "name": "mysite.com", "url": "https://mysite.com", "path": "~/mysite" }]
_seo_skill_note: Which site (by id) holds .claude/skills/blog-post.md and .claude/transcripts. Defaults to the first site in seoSites.
_nlm_note: Path to the notebooklm-mcp binary. Leave null to auto-detect on PATH / common install locations. (Or set env AGENTIC_OS_NLM_MCP_BIN.)
_location_note: Shown in the top-bar timestamp. e.g. "Bangkok", "London", or just "Local".
